role: Compute six health metrics for the Co-Being knowledge graph per D-TS-08 spec
detail: Single async function `get_health_metrics(persistence)` returns a SchemaHealthReport with six metrics: total_instance_count (INSTANCE schema_level nodes), total_type_count (SCHEMA schema_level nodes), type_coverage_ratio (fraction of instance nodes with outgoing INSTANCE_OF edges, 0.0 if no instance nodes), avg_confidence (arithmetic mean of confidence on ACTIVE status nodes, 0.0 if none), pending_proposal_count (nodes with PENDING status), orphan_node_count (nodes appearing in no edge). Uses duck typing to check for optional query_edges() method on persistence backend; when absent, type_coverage_ratio and orphan_node_count return safe zero values (0.0 and 0). Queries all nodes once, then edges only if available.
gotchas: Duck typing pattern for query_edges() method means Neo4j backend implementation deferred to future epic; edge-dependent metrics silently degrade to zero when persistence lacks query_edges(), which could mask schema evolution detection in production.
